dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: There's an old saying in Liyue: "a bed that faces the door... shall be haunted by a ghost of horror."

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: But as long as I'm here, you won't have anything to worry about.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: And if a couple of ghosts do come, you could invite them to play a game! Hmm... actually, why don't we put a table and some chairs in here? Hee-hee...
